correctness.rationale: With |A|=a and |B|=a+2 the all-crossing-negative baseline has weight 1−a; a cycle on A and three disjoint edges on B are available already at a=4 and add a+3. With s_i the incident label sum, the disjointness neighborhood contributes w−s_i−s_j+f(ij), and closing it adds f(ij) once more. In the construction s_i=−1 on A and s_j=1+ε_j on B, with ε_j in {0,1}; the crossing, A-internal and B-internal sums are at least 1, 8 and 2, respectively. A crossing pair avoids a−2 promoted cycle edges. For any signing in the stipulated class the number of promoted internal pairs is a−1+w, while the largest degrees p,q of the two promotion graphs satisfy p+q≤w−1 from the crossing inequalities. The handshake bound excludes w≤2, and at w=3 only (p,q)=(0,2) can supply a+2 edges, forcing a spanning 2-regular graph on B. An unpromoted B-pair then has closed sum 3−3−3+2=−1. This proves optimality only for the stipulated partition class. A fresh literal-neighborhood enumeration for a fixed 4+6 partition found no valid labels at weights −3 through 3 and 45 at weight 4.
residual_risks: The saved output and independent finite replay do not prove arbitrary-order statements or exclude other sign patterns. The uploaded checker prints VERIFY_OK before running assertions; its first line alone is not confirmation of successful completion.

originality.rationale: The published primary comparison covers weight 4 at n=10 and uses the same general partition strategy, but its even-order constructions have weight 5. The supported contribution is the uniform weight-four construction improving the published bound for even n≥12, together with optimality for fixed blocks of sizes a and a+2 with all crossing labels negative. Distinct later-dated catalogue entries materially reproduce or strengthen these statements; they establish non-uniqueness of the mathematical content across catalogue records, but the inspected evidence does not establish earlier coverage of this frozen finding by those entries. The search is not a priority certification.
residual_risks: The bounded search does not establish absolute originality or resolve the provenance relationship among the overlapping catalogue records.

value.rationale: Reducing the best inspected published general even bound from 5 to 4 is mathematically motivated: it reduces the possible exact values uniformly on a standard Kneser family, using one construction for both even congruence classes. The degree-capacity obstruction explains why the standard fixed-cut strategy cannot realize a still lower weight, so further unrestricted improvement would require another signing pattern. This is more than reproducing the n=10 table entry.
residual_risks: The obstruction is specific to the two block sizes and all-crossings-negative template; it does not address arbitrary distributions of negative labels.
